topicTitle: 18.2 Index of Hydrogen Deficiency or Unsaturation
explanation: An IHD of 2 means 2 degrees of unsaturation. One double bond (IHD=1) plus one ring (IHD=1) gives a total of 2. Two triple bonds would give IHD=4. A benzene ring gives IHD=4. Two single bonds contribute IHD=0.
